visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a male's face, focusing on his shimmering eye makeup and subtle red tones around the eyes. He wears a black shirt, and his hand is placed against his neck, showcasing the skin texture and reflective pigments under bright studio lighting. (2) He holds up a blue, crystal-themed eyeshadow palette, tilting it to catch the light. The background is a neutral grey-purple. The man smiles and gestures towards the product with animated facial expressions and direct eye contact with the camera, emphasizing the packaging's design. (3) Close-up shots display the palette's interior, featuring various shades like pink, silver, and burgundy. Swatches are shown on an arm to demonstrate the pigment density and shimmer effect, with the camera capturing the way the colors shift under the lights. (4) The man proceeds to apply the makeup, using professional brushes for the base and his fingers for the glittery top layers. He looks into an off-camera mirror while explaining the application steps, focusing on different parts of the eyelid and under-eye area. (5) He showcases the finished look, turning his head slowly to display the multi-dimensional shine of the eyeshadow. The lighting highlights the "crystal" effect mentioned in the subtitles, and his skin appears dewy and well-prepped, complementing the colorful eye makeup. (6) The video concludes with the brand logos for Shu Uemura and Final Fantasy XIV appearing on a black background, marking the end of the product demonstration and promotional segment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice speaks enthusiastically about the "crystal diamond light color." Background music is a mid-tempo, upbeat electronic pop track with a clear synthetic beat and pulsing bass. No significant ambient noise is present, indicating a high-quality studio recording. (2) A sharp "whoosh" sound effect accompanies the visual transition to the product reveal, adding a dynamic layer to the production. The speaker's tone remains friendly and professional, with clear articulation and high vocal arousal to engage the viewers immediately. (3) During the makeup application, the speaker's voice is continuous, explaining specific colors like "red-brown" and "lotus grey." A comedic interlude occurs where the voice adopts a singing style with a distinct reverb effect added in post-production, briefly changing the acoustic texture before returning to narration. (4) The BGM continues steadily in the background, maintaining a positive and energetic mood throughout the tutorial. Subtle "click" sounds are heard as the palette is opened and closed, which are incidental noises that add a sense of realism to the product demonstration. (5) The speaker concludes with a call to action, his voice rising in pitch and excitement while encouraging the audience to try the palette. The music swells slightly in volume before fading out as the final brand logo appears in a silent, clean outro.
